Timbre 0.3.0

Timbre no longer needs Claude Code installed, and it can now run on ChatGPT as well as Claude.

  • Sign in to Claude or ChatGPT from Timbre, through your browser
  • Timbre fetches what it needs the first time you sign in
  • Switch assistants or sign out from the menu bar
  • With no assistant, Surprise me, flipping ideas and the mix still work
